name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 125 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 117 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist and automatic scanner that catches the reasons apps get rejected from the App Store and Google Play, before you submit and lose weeks waiting.
buyer: An indie app developer or small app studio about to submit their first app who is terrified of a rejection delaying their launch.
business_use_cases: A compliance consultant sells a flat-fee 'will my app get rejected?' pre-submission audit to indie developers.
An app development agency white-labels the checklist as part of their client delivery process to avoid costly resubmission delays.
A subscription service tracks changing App Store, Google Play, and privacy-law deadlines for a portfolio of client apps.

money_ideas.idea: One-off pre-submission compliance audit fee for indie developers
Subscription ongoing compliance-monitoring retainer as store rules change

steal_this: Offer a flat $99 'will my app get rejected?' audit to indie app developers this weekend using this tool.
